title: After Decades of Blood and Mistrust, Doubts Over Who’s to Blame for an Israeli Hostage
summary_full: Israeli spies kidnapped and killed Iranians. They were convinced that Tehran was to blame for a fallen airman. Alternative theories got little attention, until now.
